== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Zenith]] Devices are the original forms of [[Aethertech]], created by human craftsmen during a historical period known as the [[Zenith Era]]. These highly advanced tools were designed with utility and the [[advancement]] of galactic civilization in mind rather than for comfort. While many consider them to be mere myths, they are actual pieces of miracle technology that possess immense power. Although their specific abilities are adaptive and depend heavily on the individuals using them, they all share certain fundamental functions. For example, some can function as starships, while others possess the capability to consume planets or hide. There are seven known [[Zenith]] Devices, including [[The Last Horizon]] (a starship), [[Shadow Ark]] (a colony), the [[Zenith Cannon]], the [[Zenith Blade]], and the [[Zenith Processor]]. These entities often exhibit distinct personalities, including high levels of ego, competitiveness, and even petty jealousy. Some devices operate under strict rules; for instance, the starship [[The Last Horizon]] maintains a symbiotic bond with a crew of exactly six members. While it is rare for more than two such devices to be active at once, all seven have been awakened. Because of their immense strength and unique properties, they are highly sought after by various factions, including the [[Iron Legion]].}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Originally created by human [[Technicians]], [[Zenith]] Devices are engineered for utility rather than comfort. These tools, which include the The Zenith Starship{{!}}Zenith Starship, operate according to highly specific rules and possess the ability to locate individuals. Ultimately, these devices are considered superior to [[Aethertech]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Regarded as the pinnacle of [[Aethertech]], the [[Zenith]] Devices are a collection of seven powerful entities. While a crew searches for these artifacts, it is known that various Aether Technician{{!}}Aether Technicians previously worked upon them. These devices are capable of activation and operate through the use of a specialized crew system.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Originally created to ensure the flourishing of galactic civilization, the [[Zenith]] Devices first awakened as seven competitors whose immense power brought an end to the [[Zenith Era]]. These entities, which possess adaptive functions and are designed for both exploration and combat, have long been a source of distrust for individuals like Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri. Following a massive hunt funded by [[Solstice]], it was revealed that the organization currently possesses two of these devices. While a pair of them were once utilized by enemies to stage an ambush against Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax, the [[Voice of Solstice]] maintains that not all secrets must be revealed to these machines.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri expresses distrust toward [[Zenith Devices]] due to his past experiences.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c2">''The Pilot'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Solstice]] funded a massive hunt for the [[Zenith Devices]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c5">''The Pilot'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Zenith Devices]] have adaptive functions.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c12">''The Pilot'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Zenith Devices]] include entities designed for combat and exploration.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c15">''The Pilot'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A pair of [[Zenith Devices]] were used by enemies to ambush Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c21">''The Pilot'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith Devices]] originally awakened as seven competitors whose might ended the [[Zenith Era]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c23">''The Pilot'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Zenith Devices]] were made to make galactic civilization flourish.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Solstice]] possesses two [[Zenith Devices]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c34">''The Pilot'', chapter 34</ref>}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|“—required to sync with Aethertech, which I believe to be the fundamental difference between modern Aethertech and the Zenith Devices.”<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“You know why the Zenith Devices were made, don’t you? We want galactic civilization to flourish.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“I’ll show you. But I don’t need to give all my secrets to the Zenith Devices.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}
